message.content: Explain main actors, a reference cycle, RAG, and attention. Does a token mean the same thing?

A main actor coordinates access to main-actor-isolated state. A reference cycle is the same strong-reference loop also called a retain cycle. RAG is retrieval-augmented generation: retrieve source text before generating an answer. Attention weighs the relevance of input representations when constructing output representations. A token is a text unit used by the model. Embeddings encode content as vectors for comparing meaning.
I want to remember attention and embeddings, and the aliases for the terms we already discussed.
